page.notes: Page is a scan of a blurred printed page with slight show-through and a neighbouring page edge at the right, left out. Doubtful readings, not marked inline because they are plausible: "finem" (f kept as a true f); "studioseq;" and "consonuio" in the sentence beginning "ego, ut patet"; "musca doceat" and "quasi non fas" are blurred, and "Cliniæ" may be read differently. The text after "ascendere." and before "Ant. Non certè" is uncertain; speaker changes may be mid-paragraph. The last line "prehen-" continues on the next page.
